All datasets used on this website, with what we learned about each one: how to access it, its resolution,
how often it is updated and its current status. All data belongs to its respective owners.

## Landsat WELD true-colour annual composite

- **Provider:** NASA GIBS (imagery: USGS/NASA Landsat)
- **Link:** <https://nasa-gibs.github.io/gibs-api-docs/>
- **Access:** Tile service (WMTS), no login
- **Spatial resolution:** 30 m (shown up to zoom 12)
- **Temporal coverage:** 2010 annual composite
- **Update frequency:** Static (historical product)
- **Status:** Active
- **License / citation:** NASA open data. Acknowledge NASA GIBS / ESDIS

## Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS) Landsat Surface Reflectance (HLSL30 v2.0)

- **Provider:** NASA GIBS (data: NASA LP DAAC, imagery: USGS/NASA Landsat 8 and 9)
- **Link:** <https://doi.org/10.5067/HLS/HLSL30.002>
- **Access:** Tile service (WMTS), no login. One layer per day
- **Spatial resolution:** 30 m (shown up to zoom 12)
- **Temporal coverage:** Nov 2020–present, daily (a few missing days)
- **Update frequency:** Daily, ~2–4 days delay
- **Status:** Active
- **License / citation:** NASA open data. Cite: Masek et al., HLS Operational Land Surface Reflectance V2.0, LP DAAC. Acknowledge NASA GIBS / ESDIS
- **Notes:** One day covers only ~10% of the US. Although Landsat 8 and 9 together revisit every 8 days, 8 days of GIBS images left about a third of the eastern US empty (checked for 30 Sep–7 Oct 2026). 16 days fill almost everything except a few small gaps. Clouds are not removed, and the edges between strips from different days are visible. The HLS_S30 layer (Sentinel-2, European) is not used because we focus on US sources.

## IMERG precipitation rate (latest)

- **Provider:** NASA GIBS (data: NASA GPM)
- **Link:** <https://nasa-gibs.github.io/gibs-api-docs/>
- **Access:** Tile service (WMTS), no login
- **Spatial resolution:** 0.1° (~10 km)
- **Temporal coverage:** Near real-time
- **Update frequency:** Every 30 minutes
- **Status:** Active
- **License / citation:** NASA open data. Acknowledge NASA GIBS / ESDIS

## GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 Monthly (GPM_3IMERGM v07)

- **Provider:** NASA GES DISC
- **Link:** <https://disc.gsfc.nasa.gov/datasets/GPM_3IMERGM_07/summary>
- **Access:** earthaccess (NASA Earthdata login)
- **Spatial resolution:** 0.1° (~10 km)
- **Temporal coverage:** 1998–present, monthly
- **Update frequency:** Monthly, ~3–4 months delay
- **Status:** Active
- **License / citation:** NASA open data. Cite: Huffman et al., GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 Monthly, V07, GES DISC
